quests.desc: You are now playing a life changing round of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. Your first objective is to take a trip east. Okay, and then, venture north. Okay, and then, go north. And then, make an attempt to head west. Then, make an attempt to go north. That done, venture east. After that, try to go east. That done, try to travel east. And then, try to travel south. With that accomplished, try to venture south. Then, head west. If you can accomplish that, retrieve the gummy bear from the floor of the chamber. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. Your first objective is to make an effort to go east. After that, attempt to go to the north. Then, make an effort to head north. And then, attempt to take a trip west. And then, travel north. And then, head east. With that done, go east. And then, make an attempt to take a trip east. And then, attempt to go to the south. And then, go to the south. Then, make an effort to head west. Next, lift the gummy bear from the floor of the chamber. And once you've done that, you win!
